notes.value: GWM ORA 07, an electric sports sedan, sold by GWM Pakistan (Sazgar) as an import in two versions. FWD (the headline here): 83.5 kWh battery, 150 kW (204 hp) and 340 Nm, 0–100 km/h 7.9 s, 640 km NEDC, 1,990 kg, PKR 15,300,000. AWD Performance: dual motors with 300 kW (402 hp) and 680 Nm, 0–100 km/h 4.3 s, 550 km NEDC, 2,115 kg, PKR 17,500,000. Both: 180 km/h, DC up to 88 kW, AC 11 kW, CCS2 and Type 2. 4,871 × 1,862 × 1,500 mm on a 2,870 mm wheelbase, 125 mm ground clearance, 333 L boot, 5 seats. PakNEV estimates 400–466 km in real-world use. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a full ADAS suite with lane centring and evasion assist, a 360° camera with transparent chassis and automatic parking, a 10.25-inch cluster and 12.3-inch touchscreen, heated and ventilated front seats, frameless doors and a panoramic glass roof. Warranty: vehicle 6 years / 150,000 km, battery 8 years / 180,000 km (PakNEV). Sources: GWM Pakistan, PakNEV.
